svg.title: How work moves through skilldrop
svg.desc: Five lifecycle stages, in order. Stage 1, discover, in the product-manager pack: Find the problem worth solving. Start here when a request, a complaint or a strategy question arrives. Gates: none; its skills, in order, with no loop. Ends with a requirement someone agreed to. Stage 2, design, in the solution-architect pack: Decide how to build it. Start here when the problem is agreed, but not the approach. Gates: G1 where a review panel decides. Ends with a recorded decision (ADR). Stage 3, build, in the dev-team pack: Build it. Start here when the work is clear enough to write down. Bug fixes start here. Gates: G2 where a script decides, G2.1 where you decide. Ends with merged code. Stage 4, release, in the dev-team pack: Ship it. Start here when a merged change needs to reach users safely. Gates: G3 where a review panel decides, G3.1 where you decide. Ends with a live, reversible rollout. Stage 5, operate, in the sre-oncall pack: Run it. Start here when the service is live, or something just broke. Gates: none; its skills, in order, with no loop. Ends with a postmortem and runbook changes. Outside the lifecycle, ship-a-draft, in the core pack: Wrap any draft. Gates: G5 where a review panel decides. Outside the lifecycle, research, in the research pack: Answer a why question. Gates: G7 where a review panel decides. Outside the lifecycle, comply, in the grc pack: Sign off a risky change. Gates: G8 where a script decides, G8.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, measure, in the data-analytics pack: Trust a dashboard's numbers. Gates: G9 where a review panel decides, G9.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, modernize, in the dev-team pack: Replace legacy code safely. Gates: G10 where a script decides, G10.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, ship-agent, in the ai-engineering pack: Ship an AI agent. Gates: G12 where a review panel decides, G12.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, provision, in the infra-as-code pack: Change infrastructure safely. Gates: G13 where a review panel decides, G13.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, clarify, in the experience-design pack: Fix a confusing service. Gates: G14 where a review panel decides. Packs for any stage: product-manager, sre-oncall, stakeholder-comms, design, api-builder, converters, trackers, frontend, skill-engineering, career, civil-architect, operations-manager, event-planner.
